summary: This CSS file styles a PostCard component with two layout variants: an enhanced card layout and a smaller card layout. It defines how the card containers, images, titles, dates, and metadata display, with careful attention to typography and hover effects. The file also notes that shared design tokens were moved to a theme file to reduce coupling between components.

explanations.15: The `composes` syntax (from CSS Modules) means this class inherits all the styles from the `mk-surface` class defined globally, then adds its own styles on top.
explanations.20: Setting `min-width: 0` on a flex container ensures child elements can shrink below their content size, preventing overflow issues.
explanations.35: The `aspect-ratio: 2 / 1` property maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio of 2:1, so the image scales responsively while keeping that proportional shape.
explanations.36: `object-fit: contain` scales the image to fit inside its box while maintaining aspect ratio, rather than stretching or cropping it.
explanations.46: The `-webkit-box` display value is needed alongside flexbox to enable the webkit-specific line-clamping properties on the next lines.
explanations.53: The `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` property truncates the text to exactly 2 lines with an ellipsis, but only works when combined with the `-webkit-box` display and `-webkit-box-orient: vertical`.
explanations.82: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` makes numbers use fixed widths instead of proportional widths, so dates align vertically in a grid.
explanations.124: The border-radius syntax `var(--mk-radius-lg) var(--mk-radius-lg) 0 0` rounds only the top two corners (top-left and top-right) while keeping bottom corners sharp.
